Pet Travel Basics

Travelers need to know that a clean, secure carrier and calm handling help keep pets safe from check-in to arrival.

If you are bringing a rabbit, please make sure the carrier meets the desk's limits. <<FACT F064>> Keep the crate easy to carry, with a firm base and enough ventilation, and give your pet a short chance to settle before you arrive. The ground team will move the carrier carefully between services, so clear labels and a closed latch make the handoff smoother.

If you are traveling with a cat, use a carrier that stays steady under the seat and leaves room for your pet to stand, turn, and lie down. <<FACT F067>> Bring a familiar blanket or pad if it helps your pet stay calm, and avoid loose items that could shift during the trip.

If you want a quick check before you go, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can walk you through the steps and help you prepare the carrier the right way.
